# Beamfall libmpv rung — native build (ADR-0017 §3, Engine 2).
#
# This builds `libbeamfall_mpv.so`, the JNI bridge between LibmpvNativeBridge (Kotlin) and the mpv
# client + render API. It links against a *vendored* `libmpv.so` and its headers.
#
# GATE SAFETY: the whole native build is opt-in. It compiles only when the vendored mpv headers are
# present under cpp/mpv-dist/include AND the kit is built with -Pbeamfall.libmpv=true (which wires
# externalNativeBuild in build.gradle.kts). Without those, this file produces no target and the kit
# AAR ships with no libbeamfall_mpv.so / no libmpv.so, so LibmpvClient.isAvailable() stays false and
# the default gate needs no NDK.

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.22.1)
project(beamfall_mpv C)

set(MPV_DIST "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/mpv-dist")
set(MPV_INCLUDE "${MPV_DIST}/include")
set(MPV_LIB "${MPV_DIST}/lib/${ANDROID_ABI}/libmpv.so")

if(NOT EXISTS "${MPV_INCLUDE}/mpv/client.h")
    message(WARNING
        "Beamfall: vendored libmpv headers not found at ${MPV_INCLUDE}/mpv/client.h — "
        "skipping native libmpv bridge. LibmpvClient.isAvailable() will remain false. "
        "Run kit/scripts/build_libmpv.sh to populate cpp/mpv-dist, then rebuild with -Pbeamfall.libmpv=true.")
    return()
endif()

add_library(beamfall_mpv SHARED beamfall_mpv.c)

target_include_directories(beamfall_mpv PRIVATE "${MPV_INCLUDE}")

find_library(log-lib log)
find_library(egl-lib EGL)
find_library(gles-lib GLESv2)

# Import the vendored libmpv.so for the current ABI.
add_library(mpv SHARED IMPORTED)
set_target_properties(mpv PROPERTIES IMPORTED_LOCATION "${MPV_LIB}")

target_link_libraries(beamfall_mpv
    mpv
    ${log-lib}
    ${egl-lib}
    ${gles-lib})
